def _state_visits(state, load, source_policy_budget, seed=None):
    matching = [
        row
        for row in state["population_visits"]
        if row[0] == load
        and row[2] == source_policy_budget
        and (seed is None or row[1] == seed)
    ]
    return sum(row[3] for row in matching), sum(row[4] for row in matching)


def _physical_signature(model, option_indices, service, duration):
    reads = 0
    offsets = []
    for coordinate in range(len(model.workloads)):
        local = []
        for option_index in option_indices:
            if option_index is None:
                continue
            for offset in model.options[option_index].completion_offsets[coordinate]:
                reads += 1
                local.append(float(offset))
        offsets.append(tuple(sorted(local)))
    return (tuple(service), float(duration), tuple(offsets)), reads


def _realizable(model, queues, selected):
    service = tuple(
        sum(
            model.options[index].requirements[coordinate]
            for index in selected.option_indices
            if index is not None
        )
        for coordinate in range(len(queues))
    )
    duration = max(
        (
            1.0,
            *(
                model.options[index].duration
                for index in selected.option_indices
                if index is not None
            ),
        )
    )
    score = sum(q * count for q, count in zip(queues, service)) / duration
    return (
        len(selected.option_indices) == model.lanes
        and service == selected.service
        and all(count <= q for count, q in zip(service, queues))
        and duration == selected.duration
        and score == selected.score
    )


def _work_identities(selection, option_count, lanes):
    return (
        selection.seed_attempts == option_count + 1
        and selection.attempts
        == selection.seed_attempts + selection.paid_search_pops
        and selection.cache_entries == selection.attempts
        and selection.cache_misses_after_seeds == selection.paid_search_pops
        and selection.cache_hits == selection.free_cache_hit_pops
        and selection.logical_search_pops
        == selection.paid_search_pops + selection.free_cache_hit_pops
        and selection.cached_feasible_reuses
        + selection.cached_infeasible_reuses
        == selection.free_cache_hit_pops
        and selection.candidate_score_evaluations
        == selection.feasible_candidate_count
        and selection.cache_key_evaluations
        == selection.seed_attempts
        + selection.logical_search_pops
        + selection.budget_blocked_cache_miss_lookups
        and selection.cache_key_item_reads
        == lanes * selection.cache_key_evaluations
        and selection.upper_bound_calls
        == selection.frontier_pushes + selection.bound_rejected_prefixes
        and selection.frontier_pushes
        == selection.logical_search_pops
        + selection.exact_stop_frontier_entries_cleared
        + selection.frontier_entries_remaining
        and selection.represented_ordered_configurations
        == (option_count + 1) ** lanes
        and selection.represented_lane_multisets
        == math.comb(option_count + lanes, lanes)
        and selection.symmetry_duplicate_ordered_configurations
        == selection.represented_ordered_configurations
        - selection.represented_lane_multisets
        and selection.cache_entries <= selection.represented_lane_multisets
        and selection.budget_blocked_cache_miss_lookups in (0, 1)
    )


def _evaluate_state(model, state_index, state):
    queues = tuple(state["queue"])
    small = select_permutation_quotient_frame(
        model.options, queues, model.lanes, SMALL_BUDGET
    )
    exact = select_permutation_quotient_frame(
        model.options, queues, model.lanes, EXACT_QUOTIENT_BUDGET
    )
    reference_score = state["support_reference_score"]
    legacy = state["legacy_k26"]
    support_regret = reference_score - small.score
    bound_slack = small.upper_bound - reference_score
    identity_error = small.gap - support_regret - bound_slack
    epsilon_error = small.epsilon - (
        small.gap / sum(queues) if sum(queues) else 0.0
    )
    legacy_signature, legacy_reads = _physical_signature(
        model,
        legacy["option_indices"],
        legacy["service"],
        legacy["duration"],
    )
    small_signature, small_reads = _physical_signature(
        model, small.option_indices, small.service, small.duration
    )
    exact_signature, exact_reads = _physical_signature(
        model, exact.option_indices, exact.service, exact.duration
    )
    score_delta = small.score - legacy["score"]
    upper_delta = small.upper_bound - legacy["upper_bound"]
    gap_delta = small.gap - legacy["gap"]
    execution_ok = (
        _realizable(model, queues, small)
        and _realizable(model, queues, exact)
        and _work_identities(small, len(model.options), model.lanes)
        and _work_identities(exact, len(model.options), model.lanes)
        and small.attempts <= SMALL_BUDGET
        and exact.attempts <= EXACT_QUOTIENT_BUDGET
        and small.represented_ordered_configurations == ORDERED_ACTION_COUNT
        and small.represented_lane_multisets == QUOTIENT_ORBIT_COUNT
        and exact.represented_ordered_configurations == ORDERED_ACTION_COUNT
        and exact.represented_lane_multisets == QUOTIENT_ORBIT_COUNT
        and exact.exact
        and exact.frontier_entries_remaining == 0
        and exact.budget_blocked_cache_miss_lookups == 0
        and abs(exact.score - reference_score) <= SCORE_TOLERANCE
        and small.score <= reference_score + SCORE_TOLERANCE
        and reference_score <= small.upper_bound + SCORE_TOLERANCE
        and abs(identity_error) <= SCORE_TOLERANCE
        and abs(epsilon_error) <= SCORE_TOLERANCE
    )
    return {
        "state_index": state_index,
        "variant_k26": asdict(small),
        "variant_k55": asdict(exact),
        "variant_finite_budget_support_regret": max(0.0, support_regret),
        "variant_frontier_bound_slack": max(0.0, bound_slack),
        "variant_gap_identity_error": identity_error,
        "variant_epsilon_error": epsilon_error,
        "support_score_delta_over_legacy_k26": score_delta,
        "upper_bound_delta_over_legacy_k26": upper_delta,
        "gap_delta_over_legacy_k26": gap_delta,
        "support_outcome": (
            "improved"
            if score_delta > SCORE_TOLERANCE
            else "regressed"
            if score_delta < -SCORE_TOLERANCE
            else "unchanged"
        ),
        "raw_lane_witness_changed_from_legacy_k26": (
            tuple(small.option_indices) != tuple(legacy["option_indices"])
        ),
        "selected_physical_signature_changed_from_legacy_k26": (
            small_signature != legacy_signature
        ),
        "variant_k26_matches_k55_physical_signature": (
            small_signature == exact_signature
        ),
        "variant_k55_support_matches_registered_reference": (
            abs(exact.score - reference_score) <= SCORE_TOLERANCE
        ),
        "selection_bound_and_work_checks_pass": execution_ok,
        "physical_signature_completion_offset_reads": (
            legacy_reads + small_reads + exact_reads
        ),
    }


def _metrics_for_population(states, evaluations, load, source_policy_budget, seed=None):
    weighted = []
    for state, evaluation in zip(states, evaluations, strict=True):
        count, visited_time = _state_visits(
            state, load, source_policy_budget, seed
        )
        if count:
            weighted.append((state, evaluation, count, visited_time))
    frame_count = sum(row[2] for row in weighted)
    visited_time = sum(row[3] for row in weighted)

    def average(function):
        return sum(
            count * function(state, evaluation)
            for state, evaluation, count, _ in weighted
        ) / frame_count

    def frames_where(function):
        return sum(
            count
            for state, evaluation, count, _ in weighted
            if function(state, evaluation)
        )

    def time_where(function):
        return sum(
            time
            for state, evaluation, _, time in weighted
            if function(state, evaluation)
        )

    def values(which, state, evaluation):
        if which == "legacy":
            selection = state["legacy_k26"]
            regret = max(
                0.0, state["support_reference_score"] - selection["score"]
            )
        else:
            selection = evaluation["variant_k26"]
            regret = evaluation["variant_finite_budget_support_regret"]
        return selection, regret, sum(state["queue"])

    def summary(which):
        return {
            "strict_support_loss_frame_count": frames_where(
                lambda state, evaluation: values(which, state, evaluation)[1]
                > SCORE_TOLERANCE
            ),
            "exact_support_score_frame_fraction": frames_where(
                lambda state, evaluation: values(which, state, evaluation)[1]
                <= SCORE_TOLERANCE
            )
            / frame_count,
            "exact_certified_frame_fraction": frames_where(
                lambda state, evaluation: values(which, state, evaluation)[0][
                    "exact"
                ]
            )
            / frame_count,
            "mean_finite_budget_support_regret": average(
                lambda state, evaluation: values(which, state, evaluation)[1]
            ),
            "mean_finite_budget_support_regret_per_visible_job": average(
                lambda state, evaluation: (
                    values(which, state, evaluation)[1]
                    / values(which, state, evaluation)[2]
                    if values(which, state, evaluation)[2]
                    else 0.0
                )
            ),
            "mean_certified_gap": average(
                lambda state, evaluation: values(which, state, evaluation)[0]["gap"]
            ),
            "mean_certified_gap_per_visible_job": average(
                lambda state, evaluation: values(which, state, evaluation)[0][
                    "epsilon"
                ]
            ),
            "mean_candidate_attempts": average(
                lambda state, evaluation: values(which, state, evaluation)[0][
                    "attempts"
                ]
            ),
        }

    legacy_summary = summary("legacy")
    variant_summary = summary("variant")
    return {
        "load": load,
        "seed": seed,
        "source_policy_budget": source_policy_budget,
        "population_role": (
            "primary frozen K26-policy states"
            if source_policy_budget == SMALL_BUDGET
            else "frozen K120-policy state sensitivity"
        ),
        "frame_count": frame_count,
        "legacy_visited_time_s": visited_time,
        "unique_queue_state_count": len(weighted),
        "support_improved_frame_count": frames_where(
            lambda _state, evaluation: evaluation["support_outcome"] == "improved"
        ),
        "support_regressed_frame_count": frames_where(
            lambda _state, evaluation: evaluation["support_outcome"] == "regressed"
        ),
        "upper_bound_worsened_frame_count": frames_where(
            lambda _state, evaluation: evaluation[
                "upper_bound_delta_over_legacy_k26"
            ]
            > SCORE_TOLERANCE
        ),
        "gap_worsened_frame_count": frames_where(
            lambda _state, evaluation: evaluation["gap_delta_over_legacy_k26"]
            > SCORE_TOLERANCE
        ),
        "selected_physical_signature_changed_frame_fraction": frames_where(
            lambda _state, evaluation: evaluation[
                "selected_physical_signature_changed_from_legacy_k26"
            ]
        )
        / frame_count,
        "selected_physical_signature_changed_time_fraction": time_where(
            lambda _state, evaluation: evaluation[
                "selected_physical_signature_changed_from_legacy_k26"
            ]
        )
        / visited_time,
        "raw_lane_witness_changed_frame_fraction": frames_where(
            lambda _state, evaluation: evaluation[
                "raw_lane_witness_changed_from_legacy_k26"
            ]
        )
        / frame_count,
        "raw_lane_witness_changed_time_fraction": time_where(
            lambda _state, evaluation: evaluation[
                "raw_lane_witness_changed_from_legacy_k26"
            ]
        )
        / visited_time,
        "mean_variant_cache_hits": average(
            lambda _state, evaluation: evaluation["variant_k26"]["cache_hits"]
        ),
        "mean_variant_logical_search_pops": average(
            lambda _state, evaluation: evaluation["variant_k26"][
                "logical_search_pops"
            ]
        ),
        "legacy": legacy_summary,
        "variant": variant_summary,
        "variant_minus_legacy": {
            key: variant_summary[key] - legacy_summary[key]
            for key in variant_summary
        },
    }


def _source_summary_matches(source_summary, shadow_summary):
    if (
        source_summary["frame_count"] != shadow_summary["frame_count"]
        or source_summary["unique_queue_state_count"]
        != shadow_summary["unique_queue_state_count"]
        or source_summary["strict_support_loss_frame_count"]
        != shadow_summary["legacy"]["strict_support_loss_frame_count"]
    ):
        return False
    float_pairs = (
        (
            source_summary["exact_score_found_by_k26_frame_fraction"],
            shadow_summary["legacy"]["exact_support_score_frame_fraction"],
        ),
        (
            source_summary["k26_exact_certified_frame_fraction"],
            shadow_summary["legacy"]["exact_certified_frame_fraction"],
        ),
        (
            source_summary["mean_finite_budget_support_regret"],
            shadow_summary["legacy"]["mean_finite_budget_support_regret"],
        ),
        (
            source_summary["mean_finite_budget_support_regret_per_visible_job"],
            shadow_summary["legacy"][
                "mean_finite_budget_support_regret_per_visible_job"
            ],
        ),
        (
            source_summary["mean_certified_gap"],
            shadow_summary["legacy"]["mean_certified_gap"],
        ),
    )
    return all(
        math.isclose(left, right, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=AGGREGATE_TOLERANCE)
        for left, right in float_pairs
    )


def _six_metric_checks(prefix, summaries):
    return {
        f"{prefix}_mean_support_regret_nonworse_at_every_load": all(
            row["variant"]["mean_finite_budget_support_regret"]
            <= row["legacy"]["mean_finite_budget_support_regret"]
            + AGGREGATE_TOLERANCE
            for row in summaries
        ),
        f"{prefix}_strict_support_loss_count_nonworse_at_every_load": all(
            row["variant"]["strict_support_loss_frame_count"]
            <= row["legacy"]["strict_support_loss_frame_count"]
            for row in summaries
        ),
        f"{prefix}_mean_certified_gap_nonworse_at_every_load": all(
            row["variant"]["mean_certified_gap"]
            <= row["legacy"]["mean_certified_gap"] + AGGREGATE_TOLERANCE
            for row in summaries
        ),
        f"{prefix}_mean_candidate_attempts_nonworse_at_every_load": all(
            row["variant"]["mean_candidate_attempts"]
            <= row["legacy"]["mean_candidate_attempts"] + AGGREGATE_TOLERANCE
            for row in summaries
        ),
        f"{prefix}_exact_support_fraction_nonworse_at_every_load": all(
            row["variant"]["exact_support_score_frame_fraction"]
            + AGGREGATE_TOLERANCE
            >= row["legacy"]["exact_support_score_frame_fraction"]
            for row in summaries
        ),
        f"{prefix}_exact_certified_fraction_nonworse_at_every_load": all(
            row["variant"]["exact_certified_frame_fraction"]
            + AGGREGATE_TOLERANCE
            >= row["legacy"]["exact_certified_frame_fraction"]
            for row in summaries
        ),
    }


def _advance_checks(primary, sensitivity, evaluations, execution_passed):
    checks = {
        "execution_passed": execution_passed,
        "no_registered_state_has_lower_k26_support": all(
            row["support_score_delta_over_legacy_k26"] >= -SCORE_TOLERANCE
            for row in evaluations
        ),
        "no_registered_state_has_higher_k26_upper_bound": all(
            row["upper_bound_delta_over_legacy_k26"] <= SCORE_TOLERANCE
            for row in evaluations
        ),
        "no_registered_state_has_higher_k26_gap": all(
            row["gap_delta_over_legacy_k26"] <= SCORE_TOLERANCE
            for row in evaluations
        ),
    }
    checks.update(_six_metric_checks("primary", primary))
    checks.update(_six_metric_checks("sensitivity", sensitivity))
    checks.update(
        {
            "at_least_one_primary_load_strictly_improves_support": any(
                row["variant"]["mean_finite_budget_support_regret"]
                < row["legacy"]["mean_finite_budget_support_regret"]
                - AGGREGATE_TOLERANCE
                or row["variant"]["exact_support_score_frame_fraction"]
                > row["legacy"]["exact_support_score_frame_fraction"]
                + AGGREGATE_TOLERANCE
                for row in primary
            ),
            "at_least_one_primary_load_strictly_improves_certificate_or_attempts": any(
                row["variant"]["mean_certified_gap"]
                < row["legacy"]["mean_certified_gap"] - AGGREGATE_TOLERANCE
                or row["variant"]["exact_certified_frame_fraction"]
                > row["legacy"]["exact_certified_frame_fraction"]
                + AGGREGATE_TOLERANCE
                or row["variant"]["mean_candidate_attempts"]
                < row["legacy"]["mean_candidate_attempts"] - AGGREGATE_TOLERANCE
                for row in primary
            ),
        }
    )
    return checks


def _decision(checks, primary, evaluations, states):
    if not checks["execution_passed"]:
        return "INVALID_EXECUTION"
    if all(checks.values()):
        return "ADVANCE_TO_AUTHORED_TRANSITION_SCREEN"
    non_improvement_keys = {
        "at_least_one_primary_load_strictly_improves_support",
        "at_least_one_primary_load_strictly_improves_certificate_or_attempts",
    }
    nonworse = all(
        value for key, value in checks.items() if key not in non_improvement_keys
    )
    registered_action_changed = any(
        evaluation["raw_lane_witness_changed_from_legacy_k26"]
        or evaluation["selected_physical_signature_changed_from_legacy_k26"]
        for evaluation in evaluations
    )
    if (
        nonworse
        and not checks["at_least_one_primary_load_strictly_improves_support"]
        and not registered_action_changed
        and checks[
            "at_least_one_primary_load_strictly_improves_certificate_or_attempts"
        ]
    ):
        return "EFFICIENCY_ONLY_STOP"
    return "CLOSE_WITHOUT_TRANSITION_SCREEN"


def register(output=DEFAULT_OUTPUT):
    output, protocol_path, sources_path = _paths(output)
    if any(path.exists() for path in (output, protocol_path, sources_path)):
        raise ValueError("permutation-quotient shadow artifacts already exist")
    diagnostic, model = _validate_source_diagnostic()
    roster = _validated_roster(diagnostic)
    _validate_closed_sidecar()
    if (
        (len(model.options) + 1) ** model.lanes != ORDERED_ACTION_COUNT
        or math.comb(len(model.options) + model.lanes, model.lanes)
        != QUOTIENT_ORBIT_COUNT
    ):
        raise ValueError("registered ordered-action or quotient-orbit count changed")
    protocol = {
        "registered_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "experiment": "aligned_hardware_permutation_quotient_state_shadow_v1",
        "role": ROLE,
        "source_experiment": SOURCE_DIAGNOSTIC.name,
        "registered_state_roster": REGISTERED_STATES.name,
        "closed_predecessor": CLOSED_SIDECAR_RESULT.name,
        "loads": list(LOADS),
        "seeds": list(SEEDS),
        "source_policy_budgets": list(SOURCE_POLICY_BUDGETS),
        "small_checkpoint_budget": SMALL_BUDGET,
        "exact_quotient_budget": EXACT_QUOTIENT_BUDGET,
        "state_count": STATE_COUNT,
        "ordered_action_count": ORDERED_ACTION_COUNT,
        "quotient_orbit_count": QUOTIENT_ORBIT_COUNT,
        "model": model.snapshot(),
        "registered_state_schema": REGISTERED_STATE_SCHEMA,
        "rule": RULE,
        "source_population_summaries": diagnostic[
            "summary_by_load_and_source_policy"

"""Drain an authored visible queue after one fixed first-frame action.

This helper has no arrival process.  Jobs are already visible at time zero and
may carry nonpositive authored arrival times to represent FIFO age.  The first
selection is supplied by the caller; every later frame uses one common
continuation selector on released queue counts only.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import deque
from dataclasses import dataclass
import math
from statistics import mean
from typing import Any, Callable, Sequence

from algorithm.budgeted_frame_candidates import select_budgeted_frame


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FixedFrameAction:
    option_indices: tuple[int | None, ...]
    service: tuple[int, ...]
    duration: float
    score: float
    attempts: int = 0
    bound_option_probes: int = 0
    bound_threshold_evaluations: int = 0
    local_score_evaluations: int = 0
    feasible_candidate_count: int = 0


def fixed_frame_action(model: Any, queues: Sequence[int], option_indices) -> FixedFrameAction:
    """Materialize one feasible raw lane tuple for an authored execution check."""
    indices = tuple(option_indices)
    if len(queues) != len(model.workloads) or any(
        int(value) != value or value < 0 for value in queues
    ):
        raise ValueError("queues must match the model's nonnegative integer coordinates")
    queue = tuple(int(value) for value in queues)
    if len(indices) != model.lanes:
        raise ValueError("fixed action lane count differs from the model")
    if any(index is not None and not 0 <= index < len(model.options) for index in indices):
        raise ValueError("fixed action contains an unknown option index")
    service = tuple(
        sum(
            model.options[index].requirements[coordinate]
            for index in indices
            if index is not None
        )
        for coordinate in range(len(queue))
    )
    if any(count > available for count, available in zip(service, queue, strict=True)):
        raise ValueError("fixed action exceeds the visible queue")
    duration = max((
        1.0,
        *(model.options[index].duration for index in indices if index is not None),
    ))
    score = sum(q * count for q, count in zip(queue, service, strict=True)) / duration
    return FixedFrameAction(indices, service, duration, score)


def authored_arrival_times(
    queues: Sequence[int], profile: str
) -> tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...]:
    """Create one frozen FIFO-age profile for a visible queue."""
    if any(int(value) != value or value < 0 for value in queues):
        raise ValueError("queues must contain nonnegative integer job counts")
    counts = tuple(int(value) for value in queues)
    if profile == "coincident":
        return tuple((0.0,) * count for count in counts)
    if profile == "unit_fifo":
        return tuple(
            tuple(float(index - count + 1) for index in range(count))
            for count in counts
        )
    raise ValueError("profile must be 'coincident' or 'unit_fifo'")


def drain_initial_population(
    model: Any,
    arrival_times: Sequence[Sequence[float]],
    budget: int,
    first_action: Any,
    *,
    continuation: Callable[..., Any] = select_budgeted_frame,
) -> dict:
    """Execute one fixed action, then a common selector until the queue drains."""
    if len(arrival_times) != len(model.workloads):
        raise ValueError("arrival-time coordinates must match the model workloads")
    normalized = []
    for times in arrival_times:
        values = tuple(float(value) for value in times)
        if any(not math.isfinite(value) or value > 0.0 for value in values):
            raise ValueError("authored arrival times must be finite and nonpositive")
        if any(left > right for left, right in zip(values, values[1:])):
            raise ValueError("authored arrival times must be in FIFO order")
        normalized.append(values)
    queues = [
        deque((arrival, index) for index, arrival in enumerate(times))
        for times in normalized
    ]
    job_count = sum(len(queue) for queue in queues)
    if job_count == 0:
        raise ValueError("the authored transition requires a nonempty queue")

    now = 0.0
    frame_index = 0
    initial_age_area = -sum(sum(times) for times in normalized)
    deferred_area = 0.0
    dispatch_area = 0.0
    completion_records = []
    frame_trace = []
    work_fields = (
        "attempts",
        "bound_option_probes",
        "bound_threshold_evaluations",
        "local_score_evaluations",
        "feasible_candidate_count",
        "cache_hits",
        "logical_search_pops",
        "upper_bound_calls",
    )
    work = dict.fromkeys(work_fields, 0)

    while any(queues):
        before = tuple(len(queue) for queue in queues)
        selected = (
            first_action
            if frame_index == 0
            else continuation(model.options, before, model.lanes, budget)
        )
        if len(selected.option_indices) != model.lanes:
            raise ValueError("selected lane count differs from the model")
        duration = float(selected.duration)
        if not math.isfinite(duration) or duration <= 0.0:
            raise ValueError("selected duration must be positive and finite")
        if sum(selected.service) <= 0:
            raise ValueError("a nonempty authored queue selected no service")
        for name in work_fields:
            work[name] += getattr(selected, name, 0)

        departures = [0] * len(queues)
        dispatch_this_frame = 0.0
        for option_index in selected.option_indices:
            if option_index is None:
                continue
            option = model.options[option_index]
            for coordinate, offsets in enumerate(option.completion_offsets):
                for offset in offsets:
                    offset = float(offset)
                    if offset < 0.0 or offset > duration:
                        raise ValueError("completion offset lies outside its frame")
                    if not queues[coordinate]:
                        raise ValueError("selected action exceeds the visible FIFO queue")
                    arrival, job_index = queues[coordinate].popleft()
                    completion = now + offset
                    flow = completion - arrival
                    initial_age = -arrival
                    completion_records.append({
                        "coordinate": coordinate,
                        "job_index": job_index,
                        "arrival_s": arrival,
                        "completion_s": completion,
                        "flow_s": flow,
                        "initial_age_s": initial_age,
                        "deferred_visible_wait_s": now,
                        "dispatch_to_completion_s": offset,
                        "frame_index": frame_index,
                        "option_index": option_index,
                        "completion_offset_s": offset,
                    })
                    dispatch_this_frame += offset
                    departures[coordinate] += 1
        if tuple(departures) != tuple(selected.service):
            raise ValueError("selected service differs from executed departures")
        deferred_this_frame = sum(
            (count - served) * duration
            for count, served in zip(before, departures, strict=True)
        )
        deferred_area += deferred_this_frame
        dispatch_area += dispatch_this_frame
        after = tuple(len(queue) for queue in queues)
        frame_trace.append({
            "frame_index": frame_index,
            "start_s": now,
            "duration_s": duration,
            "queue_before": before,
            "departures": tuple(departures),
            "queue_after": after,
            "option_indices": tuple(selected.option_indices),
            "score": float(selected.score),
            "attempts": int(selected.attempts),
            "deferred_visible_area_job_s": deferred_this_frame,
            "dispatch_to_completion_area_job_s": dispatch_this_frame,
        })
        now += duration
        frame_index += 1
        if frame_index > job_count:
            raise ValueError("authored population failed to drain within one service per frame")

    flows = [row["flow_s"] for row in completion_records]
    ordered_flows = sorted(flows)
    direct_area = sum(flows)
    decomposed_area = initial_age_area + deferred_area + dispatch_area
    if len(flows) != job_count:
        raise ValueError("authored drain did not complete the initial population")
    if not math.isclose(direct_area, decomposed_area, rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-9):
        raise ValueError("authored flow-area identity failed")
    return {
        "job_count": job_count,
        "completed_jobs": len(flows),
        "frame_count": frame_index,
        "continuation_selector_calls": frame_index - 1,
        "elapsed_frame_barriers_s": now,
        "makespan_s": max(row["completion_s"] for row in completion_records),
        "mean_flow_s": mean(flows),
        "p90_flow_s": ordered_flows[math.ceil(0.9 * job_count) - 1],
        "maximum_flow_s": ordered_flows[-1],
        "flow_area_job_s": direct_area,
        "flow_area_components_job_s": {
            "initial_age": initial_age_area,
            "deferred_visible": deferred_area,
            "dispatch_to_completion": dispatch_area,
        },
        "flow_area_identity_error_job_s": direct_area - decomposed_area,
        "selection_work": work,
        "frame_trace": frame_trace,
        "completion_records": completion_records,
    }

def _case_roster(predecessor, roster):
    cases = []
    for change in predecessor["state_changes"]:
        index = change["state_index"]
        state = roster["states"][index]
        if state["queue"] != change["queue"]:
            raise ValueError("transition predecessor state index and queue disagree")
        primary_visits = [
            [visit[0], visit[1], visit[3], visit[4]]
            for visit in state["population_visits"]
            if visit[2] == BUDGET
        ]
        expected_primary_visits = sum(visit[2] for visit in primary_visits)
        if expected_primary_visits != change["primary_frame_visits"]:
            raise ValueError("transition predecessor primary visit count changed")
        cases.append({
            "state_index": index,
            "queue": state["queue"],
            "primary_population_visits": primary_visits,
            "legacy_option_indices": change["legacy_option_indices"],
            "variant_option_indices": change["variant_option_indices"],
            "registered_support_score_delta": change[
                "support_score_delta_over_legacy_k26"
            ],
        })
    return cases


def _validate_predecessor():
    predecessor = json.loads(PREDECESSOR.read_text())
    execution_checks = predecessor.get("checks", {})
    advance_checks = predecessor.get("shadow_advance_checks", {})
    if (
        predecessor.get("experiment")
        != "aligned_hardware_permutation_quotient_state_shadow_v1"
        or predecessor.get("status") != "PASS"
        or frozenset(execution_checks) != PREDECESSOR_EXECUTION_CHECK_KEYS
        or not all(execution_checks.values())
        or frozenset(advance_checks) != PREDECESSOR_ADVANCE_CHECK_KEYS
        or not all(advance_checks.values())
        or predecessor.get("scientific_decision")
        != "ADVANCE_TO_AUTHORED_TRANSITION_SCREEN"
        or predecessor.get("development_advance") is not True
        or predecessor.get("retained_change_state_count") != STATE_COUNT
        or len(predecessor.get("state_changes", ())) != STATE_COUNT
    ):
        raise ValueError("transition requires the completed advancing quotient shadow")
    if any(
        change["support_outcome"] != "improved"
        or change["support_score_delta_over_legacy_k26"] <= TOLERANCE
        or not change["raw_lane_witness_changed_from_legacy_k26"]
        or not change["selected_physical_signature_changed_from_legacy_k26"]
        for change in predecessor["state_changes"]
    ):
        raise ValueError("transition predecessor changed-state roster is not strict")
    diagnostic, model = predecessor_shadow._validate_source_diagnostic()
    roster = predecessor_shadow._validated_roster(diagnostic)
    if (
        predecessor_shadow.REGISTERED_STATES.resolve() != REGISTERED_STATES.resolve()
        or roster.get("source_experiment")
        != predecessor["protocol"]["source_experiment"]
        or predecessor["protocol"]["registered_state_roster"]
        != REGISTERED_STATES.name
    ):
        raise ValueError("transition registered source-state lineage changed")
    if _json(model.snapshot()) != predecessor["protocol"]["model"]:
        raise ValueError("transition model changed from its quotient shadow")
    cases = _case_roster(predecessor, roster)
    if (
        len(cases) != STATE_COUNT
        or [row["state_index"] for row in cases]
        != sorted(row["state_index"] for row in cases)
        or len({tuple(row["queue"]) for row in cases}) != STATE_COUNT
    ):
        raise ValueError("transition changed-state case roster changed")
    expected_cells = {(load, seed) for load in LOADS for seed in SEEDS}
    observed_cells = {
        (visit[0], visit[1])
        for case in cases
        for visit in case["primary_population_visits"]
        if visit[2] > 0
    }
    if observed_cells != expected_cells:
        raise ValueError("transition changed states do not cover all nine primary cells")
    _source_texts()
    return predecessor, roster, model, cases


def _physical_signature(model, option_indices):
    service = tuple(
        sum(
            model.options[index].requirements[coordinate]
            for index in option_indices
            if index is not None
        )
        for coordinate in range(len(model.workloads))
    )
    duration = max((
        1.0,
        *(model.options[index].duration for index in option_indices if index is not None),
    ))
    offsets = tuple(
        tuple(sorted(
            offset
            for index in option_indices
            if index is not None
            for offset in model.options[index].completion_offsets[coordinate]
        ))
        for coordinate in range(len(model.workloads))
    )
    return service, duration, offsets


def _selection_realizable(model, queue, selected):
    signature = _physical_signature(model, selected.option_indices)
    score = sum(
        q * served for q, served in zip(queue, signature[0], strict=True)
    ) / signature[1]
    return (
        tuple(selected.service) == signature[0]
        and selected.duration == signature[1]
        and selected.score == score
        and all(served <= q for served, q in zip(signature[0], queue, strict=True))
    )


def _trace_signature(branch):
    return [
        (
            tuple(frame["queue_before"]),
            tuple(frame["departures"]),
            tuple(frame["queue_after"]),
            tuple(frame["option_indices"]),
            frame["duration_s"],
        )
        for frame in branch["frame_trace"]
    ]


def _branch_execution_ok(branch, queue, maximum_duration):
    components = branch["flow_area_components_job_s"]
    return (
        branch["job_count"] == branch["completed_jobs"] == sum(queue)
        and branch["frame_count"] == branch["continuation_selector_calls"] + 1
        and branch["frame_count"] <= sum(queue)
        and branch["elapsed_frame_barriers_s"]
        <= sum(queue) * maximum_duration + TOLERANCE
        and abs(branch["flow_area_identity_error_job_s"]) <= TOLERANCE
        and math.isclose(
            branch["flow_area_job_s"],
            sum(components.values()),
            rel_tol=0.0,
            abs_tol=TOLERANCE,
        )
        and tuple(branch["frame_trace"][0]["queue_before"]) == tuple(queue)
    )


def _run_fixture(model):
    queue = tuple(FIXTURE["queue"])
    forward_indices = tuple(FIXTURE["forward_raw_option_indices"])
    reverse_indices = tuple(FIXTURE["reverse_raw_option_indices"])
    forward_action = fixed_frame_action(model, queue, forward_indices)
    reverse_action = fixed_frame_action(model, queue, reverse_indices)

    def forbidden_continuation(*_args, **_kwargs):
        raise AssertionError("the one-frame raw-lane fixture unexpectedly continued")

    profiles = []
    for profile in AGE_PROFILES:
        arrivals = authored_arrival_times(queue, profile)
        forward = drain_initial_population(
            model,
            arrivals,
            BUDGET,
            forward_action,
            continuation=forbidden_continuation,
        )
        reverse = drain_initial_population(
            model,
            arrivals,
            BUDGET,
            reverse_action,
            continuation=forbidden_continuation,
        )
        profiles.append({
            "profile": profile,
            "forward": forward,
            "reverse": reverse,
            "mean_delta_s": reverse["mean_flow_s"] - forward["mean_flow_s"],
            "p90_delta_s": reverse["p90_flow_s"] - forward["p90_flow_s"],
        })
    by_profile = {row["profile"]: row for row in profiles}
    coincident_forward = sorted(
        row["flow_s"] for row in by_profile["coincident"]["forward"]["completion_records"]
    )
    coincident_reverse = sorted(
        row["flow_s"] for row in by_profile["coincident"]["reverse"]["completion_records"]
    )
    checks = {
        "raw_tuples_are_reversals_of_one_multiset": (
            forward_indices != reverse_indices
            and tuple(sorted(forward_indices)) == tuple(sorted(reverse_indices))
        ),
        "service_duration_and_completion_offset_multiset_match": (
            _physical_signature(model, forward_indices)
            == _physical_signature(model, reverse_indices)
        ),
        "both_profiles_preserve_equal_mean_and_makespan": all(
            abs(row["mean_delta_s"]) <= TOLERANCE
            and abs(
                row["reverse"]["makespan_s"] - row["forward"]["makespan_s"]
            )
            <= TOLERANCE
            for row in profiles
        ),
        "coincident_profile_has_identical_sorted_flows": all(
            math.isclose(left, right, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=TOLERANCE)
            for left, right in zip(
                coincident_forward, coincident_reverse, strict=True
            )
        ),
        "unit_fifo_profile_exposes_raw_lane_p90_difference": abs(
            by_profile["unit_fifo"]["p90_delta_s"]
        )
        > TOLERANCE,
    }
    return {"specification": FIXTURE, "profiles": profiles, "checks": checks}


def _run_case(model, case, maximum_duration):
    queue = tuple(case["queue"])
    profiles = []
    for profile in AGE_PROFILES:
        arrivals = authored_arrival_times(queue, profile)
        baseline_action = select_budgeted_frame(
            model.options, queue, model.lanes, BUDGET
        )
        variant_action = select_permutation_quotient_frame(
            model.options, queue, model.lanes, BUDGET
        )
        baseline = drain_initial_population(
            model,
            arrivals,
            BUDGET,
            baseline_action,
            continuation=select_budgeted_frame,
        )
        variant = drain_initial_population(
            model,
            arrivals,
            BUDGET,
            variant_action,
            continuation=select_budgeted_frame,
        )
        profiles.append({
            "profile": profile,
            "baseline_first_action": asdict(baseline_action),
            "variant_first_action": asdict(variant_action),
            "first_actions_realizable": (
                _selection_realizable(model, queue, baseline_action)
                and _selection_realizable(model, queue, variant_action)
            ),
            "baseline": baseline,
            "variant": variant,
            "flow_area_delta_job_s": (
                variant["flow_area_job_s"] - baseline["flow_area_job_s"]
            ),
            "mean_flow_delta_s": variant["mean_flow_s"] - baseline["mean_flow_s"],
            "p90_flow_delta_s": variant["p90_flow_s"] - baseline["p90_flow_s"],
            "makespan_delta_s": variant["makespan_s"] - baseline["makespan_s"],
            "deferred_visible_delta_job_s": (
                variant["flow_area_components_job_s"]["deferred_visible"]
                - baseline["flow_area_components_job_s"]["deferred_visible"]
            ),
            "dispatch_to_completion_delta_job_s": (
                variant["flow_area_components_job_s"]["dispatch_to_completion"]
                - baseline["flow_area_components_job_s"]["dispatch_to_completion"]
            ),
        })
    by_profile = {row["profile"]: row for row in profiles}
    coincident = by_profile["coincident"]
    unit_fifo = by_profile["unit_fifo"]
    first_actions_match = all(
        row["first_actions_realizable"]
        and
        tuple(row["baseline_first_action"]["option_indices"])
        == tuple(case["legacy_option_indices"])
        and tuple(row["variant_first_action"]["option_indices"])
        == tuple(case["variant_option_indices"])
        for row in profiles
    )
    # The actions are recomputed per profile. Their scores must retain the
    # registered fixed-state improvement without using authored ages.
    support_deltas = [
        row["variant_first_action"]["score"]
        - row["baseline_first_action"]["score"]
        for row in profiles
    ]
    checks = {
        "registered_first_actions_reproduced": first_actions_match,
        "variant_first_action_support_improvement_reproduced": all(
            math.isclose(
                delta,
                case["registered_support_score_delta"],
                rel_tol=0.0,
                abs_tol=TOLERANCE,
            )
            and delta > TOLERANCE
            for delta in support_deltas
        ),
        "both_arms_and_profiles_complete_within_bound": all(
            _branch_execution_ok(row[arm], queue, maximum_duration)
            for row in profiles
            for arm in ("baseline", "variant")
        ),
        "age_profiles_do_not_change_queue_or_action_paths": (
            _trace_signature(coincident["baseline"])
            == _trace_signature(unit_fifo["baseline"])
            and _trace_signature(coincident["variant"])
            == _trace_signature(unit_fifo["variant"])
        ),
        "age_profiles_have_identical_total_flow_effect": math.isclose(
            coincident["flow_area_delta_job_s"],
            unit_fifo["flow_area_delta_job_s"],
            rel_tol=0.0,
            abs_tol=TOLERANCE,
        ),
        "paired_flow_component_identity_holds": all(
            abs(
                row["flow_area_delta_job_s"]
                - row["deferred_visible_delta_job_s"]
                - row["dispatch_to_completion_delta_job_s"]
            )
            <= TOLERANCE
            for row in profiles
        ),
    }
    return {
        **case,
        "profiles": profiles,
        "unique_state_flow_area_delta_job_s": coincident[
            "flow_area_delta_job_s"
        ],
        "unique_state_mean_flow_delta_s": coincident["mean_flow_delta_s"],
        "checks": checks,
    }


def _visit_count(case, load, seed):
    return sum(
        visit[2]
        for visit in case["primary_population_visits"]
        if visit[0] == load and visit[1] == seed
    )


def _cell_summaries(cases):
    summaries = []
    for load in LOADS:
        for seed in SEEDS:
            visits = [(_visit_count(case, load, seed), case) for case in cases]
            total_visits = sum(count for count, _ in visits)
            summaries.append({
                "load": load,
                "seed": seed,
                "changed_state_visit_count": total_visits,
                "visited_changed_state_count": sum(count > 0 for count, _ in visits),
                "occurrence_weighted_flow_area_delta_job_s_per_changed_state_visit": (
                    sum(
                        count * case["unique_state_flow_area_delta_job_s"]
                        for count, case in visits
                    )
                    / total_visits
                ),
                "occurrence_weighted_mean_flow_delta_s": (
                    sum(
                        count * case["unique_state_mean_flow_delta_s"]
                        for count, case in visits
                    )
                    / total_visits
                ),
                "occurrence_weighted_p90_delta_s_by_profile": {
                    profile: sum(
                        count
                        * next(
                            row["p90_flow_delta_s"]
                            for row in case["profiles"]
                            if row["profile"] == profile
                        )
                        for count, case in visits
                    )
                    / total_visits
                    for profile in AGE_PROFILES
                },
            })
    return summaries


def _scientific_checks(cases, cells, execution_passed):
    return {
        "execution_passed": execution_passed,
        "all_16_unique_state_mean_flow_deltas_nonpositive": all(
            case["unique_state_mean_flow_delta_s"] <= TOLERANCE for case in cases
        ),
        "all_32_state_profile_nearest_rank_p90_deltas_nonpositive": all(
            profile["p90_flow_delta_s"] <= TOLERANCE
            for case in cases
            for profile in case["profiles"]
        ),
        "all_9_primary_load_seed_weighted_flow_area_deltas_nonpositive": all(
            row[
                "occurrence_weighted_flow_area_delta_job_s_per_changed_state_visit"
            ]
            <= TOLERANCE
            for row in cells
        ),
        "at_least_one_unique_state_has_strict_mean_flow_improvement": any(
            case["unique_state_mean_flow_delta_s"] < -TOLERANCE for case in cases
        ),
        "at_least_one_primary_load_seed_cell_has_strict_weighted_flow_area_improvement": any(
            row[
                "occurrence_weighted_flow_area_delta_job_s_per_changed_state_visit"
            ]
            < -TOLERANCE
            for row in cells
        ),
    }


def _decision(checks):
    if not checks["execution_passed"]:
        return "INVALID_EXECUTION"
    if (
        not checks["all_16_unique_state_mean_flow_deltas_nonpositive"]
        or not checks[
            "all_9_primary_load_seed_weighted_flow_area_deltas_nonpositive"
        ]
    ):
        return "LOCAL_FLOW_TRADEOFF_STOP"
    if not checks[
        "all_32_state_profile_nearest_rank_p90_deltas_nonpositive"
    ]:
        return "TAIL_TRADEOFF_STOP"
    if (
        not checks["at_least_one_unique_state_has_strict_mean_flow_improvement"]
        or not checks[
            "at_least_one_primary_load_seed_cell_has_strict_weighted_flow_area_improvement"
        ]
    ):
        return "NO_LOCAL_FLOW_BENEFIT_STOP"
    return "ADVANCE_TO_FULL_DEVELOPMENT_TRAJECTORIES"

algorithm/fifo_execution_quotient_frame_:
"""Budgeted v4 search with exact FIFO-execution candidate reuse.

The logical prefix heap, option order, support objective, upper bound, and raw
lane-order tie break are the same as :mod:`algorithm.budgeted_frame_candidates`.
After the paid seeds, the first action with a given aggregate service, duration,
and per-class FIFO-ordered completion offsets pays for construction and
feasibility. Later actions with exactly that execution signature reuse the
result without consuming candidate budget. Lane permutations with different
FIFO pairing remain distinct paid candidates.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import heapq
import math
from typing import Any, Sequence


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FifoExecutionQuotientFrameSelection:
    option_indices: tuple[int | None, ...]
    service: tuple[int, ...]
    duration: float
    score: float
    upper_bound: float
    gap: float
    epsilon: float
    attempts: int
    seed_attempts: int
    feasible_candidate_count: int
    local_score_evaluations: int
    bound_option_probes: int
    bound_threshold_evaluations: int
    frontier_peak: int
    exact: bool
    represented_ordered_configurations: int
    cache_entries: int
    cache_hits: int
    cache_misses_after_seeds: int
    seed_signature_collisions: int
    logical_search_pops: int
    paid_search_pops: int
    free_cache_hit_pops: int
    cached_feasible_reuses: int
    cached_infeasible_reuses: int
    candidate_score_evaluations: int
    cache_key_evaluations: int
    cache_key_item_reads: int
    cache_key_requirement_coordinate_reads: int
    cache_key_duration_reads: int
    cache_key_completion_offset_reads: int
    budget_blocked_cache_miss_lookups: int
    upper_bound_calls: int
    frontier_pushes: int
    bound_rejected_prefixes: int
    exact_stop_frontier_entries_cleared: int
    frontier_entries_remaining: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Prefix:
    indices: tuple[int | None, ...]
    service: tuple[int, ...]
    numerator: int
    duration: float
    next_index: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Candidate:
    feasible: bool
    service: tuple[int, ...]
    numerator: int
    duration: float
    score: float


def _signature_from_normalized(
    requirements: Sequence[tuple[int, ...]],
    durations: Sequence[float],
    completion_offsets: Sequence[tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...]],
    option_indices: Sequence[int | None],
    lanes: int,
    dimensions: int,
    idle_duration: float,
) -> tuple[tuple, int, int, int, int]:
    indices = tuple(option_indices)
    padded = indices + (None,) * (lanes - len(indices))
    service = [0] * dimensions
    duration = idle_duration
    ordered_offsets = [[] for _ in range(dimensions)]
    requirement_reads = 0
    duration_reads = 0
    offset_reads = 0
    for index in padded:
        if index is None:
            continue
        duration_reads += 1
        duration = max(duration, durations[index])
        for coordinate, count in enumerate(requirements[index]):
            requirement_reads += 1
            service[coordinate] += count
            local = completion_offsets[index][coordinate]
            offset_reads += len(local)
            ordered_offsets[coordinate].extend(local)
    signature = (
        tuple(service),
        duration,
        tuple(tuple(local) for local in ordered_offsets),
    )
    return signature, len(padded), requirement_reads, duration_reads, offset_reads


def fifo_execution_signature(
    options: Sequence[Any],
    option_indices: Sequence[int | None],
    lanes: int,
    dimensions: int,
    idle_duration: float = 1.0,
) -> tuple:
    """Return the exact execution key used by the post-seed cache.

    Completion offsets are concatenated separately for each class in raw lane
    order and in each option's stored local order. ``option_indices`` may be a
    search prefix; trailing lanes are padded with idle.
    """
    options = tuple(options)
    indices = tuple(option_indices)
    if int(lanes) != lanes or lanes < 1:
        raise ValueError("lanes must be a positive integer")
    lanes = int(lanes)
    if int(dimensions) != dimensions or dimensions < 0:
        raise ValueError("dimensions must be a nonnegative integer")
    dimensions = int(dimensions)
    if len(indices) > lanes:
        raise ValueError("option_indices cannot exceed the lane count")
    if any(
        index is not None
        and (int(index) != index or not 0 <= int(index) < len(options))
        for index in indices
    ):
        raise ValueError("option_indices contains an unknown option")
    indices = tuple(None if index is None else int(index) for index in indices)
    idle_duration = float(idle_duration)
    if not math.isfinite(idle_duration) or idle_duration <= 0.0:
        raise ValueError("idle_duration must be positive and finite")

    requirements: list[tuple[int, ...]] = []
    durations: list[float] = []
    offsets: list[tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...]] = []
    for option in options:
        counts = tuple(option.requirements)
        if len(counts) != dimensions or any(
            int(value) != value or value < 0 for value in counts
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "option requirements must match the nonnegative integer dimensions"
            )
        counts = tuple(int(value) for value in counts)
        if not any(counts):
            raise ValueError("a non-idle option must require at least one job")
        raw_duration = float(option.duration)
        if not math.isfinite(raw_duration) or raw_duration <= 0.0:
            raise ValueError("option durations must be positive and finite")
        duration = max(idle_duration, raw_duration)
        raw_offsets = tuple(option.completion_offsets)
        if len(raw_offsets) != dimensions:
            raise ValueError("option completion offsets must match the dimensions")
        normalized = tuple(
            tuple(float(offset) for offset in coordinate_offsets)
            for coordinate_offsets in raw_offsets
        )
        if tuple(map(len, normalized)) != counts or any(
            not math.isfinite(offset) or offset < 0.0 or offset > duration
            for coordinate_offsets in normalized
            for offset in coordinate_offsets
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "completion offsets must match requirements and lie inside the frame"
            )
        requirements.append(counts)
        durations.append(duration)
        offsets.append(normalized)
    signature, *_ = _signature_from_normalized(
        requirements,
        durations,
        offsets,
        indices,
        lanes,
        dimensions,
        idle_duration,
    )
    return signature


def select_fifo_execution_quotient_frame(
    options: Sequence[Any],
    queues: Sequence[int],
    lanes: int,
    budget: int,
    idle_duration: float = 1.0,
) -> FifoExecutionQuotientFrameSelection:
    """Select a frame while charging each exact FIFO execution once.

    ``budget`` counts the all-idle and homogeneous seed attempts plus cache
    misses reached by the unchanged logical v4 search. Cache hits retain the
    raw ordered tuple for v4's duration/index tie break and expand its original
    prefix, but do not repeat feasibility or score computation. Once the paid
    budget is exhausted, consecutive cache hits are drained until the next
    miss so the returned frontier bound reflects all free quotient work. Every
    seed remains paid even if two catalogue entries share one signature.
    """
    options = tuple(options)
    if int(lanes) != lanes or lanes < 1:
        raise ValueError("lanes must be a positive integer")
    lanes = int(lanes)
    seed_attempts = len(options) + 1
    if int(budget) != budget or budget < seed_attempts:
        raise ValueError(f"budget must be an integer covering {seed_attempts} seed attempts")
    budget = int(budget)
    idle_duration = float(idle_duration)
    if not math.isfinite(idle_duration) or idle_duration <= 0.0:
        raise ValueError("idle_duration must be positive and finite")
    if any(int(value) != value or value < 0 for value in queues):
        raise ValueError("queues must contain nonnegative integer job counts")
    queue = tuple(int(value) for value in queues)
    requirements: list[tuple[int, ...]] = []
    durations: list[float] = []
    completion_offsets: list[tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...]] = []
    weights: list[int] = []
    for option in options:
        counts = tuple(option.requirements)
        if len(counts) != len(queue) or any(
            int(value) != value or value < 0 for value in counts
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "option requirements must match the nonnegative integer queue coordinates"
            )
        counts = tuple(int(value) for value in counts)
        if not any(counts):
            raise ValueError("a non-idle option must require at least one job")
        duration = float(option.duration)
        if not math.isfinite(duration) or duration <= 0.0:
            raise ValueError("option durations must be positive and finite")
        raw_offsets = tuple(option.completion_offsets)
        if len(raw_offsets) != len(queue):
            raise ValueError("option completion offsets must match queue coordinates")
        normalized_offsets = tuple(
            tuple(float(offset) for offset in coordinate_offsets)
            for coordinate_offsets in raw_offsets
        )
        effective_duration = max(idle_duration, duration)
        if any(
            not math.isfinite(offset)
            or offset < 0.0
            or offset > effective_duration
            for coordinate_offsets in normalized_offsets
            for offset in coordinate_offsets
        ):
            raise ValueError("completion offsets must be finite and inside the frame")
        if tuple(map(len, normalized_offsets)) != counts:
            raise ValueError("completion-offset counts must equal option requirements")
        requirements.append(counts)
        durations.append(effective_duration)
        completion_offsets.append(normalized_offsets)
        weights.append(sum(q * count for q, count in zip(queue, counts)))

    represented_ordered = (len(options) + 1) ** lanes

    def pad(indices: tuple[int | None, ...]) -> tuple[int | None, ...]:
        return indices + (None,) * (lanes - len(indices))

    cache_key_evaluations = 0
    cache_key_item_reads = 0
    cache_key_requirement_coordinate_reads = 0
    cache_key_duration_reads = 0
    cache_key_completion_offset_reads = 0

    def cache_key(indices: tuple[int | None, ...]) -> tuple:
        nonlocal cache_key_evaluations, cache_key_item_reads
        nonlocal cache_key_requirement_coordinate_reads, cache_key_duration_reads
        nonlocal cache_key_completion_offset_reads
        signature, items, requirement_reads, duration_reads, offset_reads = (
            _signature_from_normalized(
                requirements,
                durations,
                completion_offsets,
                indices,
                lanes,
                len(queue),
                idle_duration,
            )
        )
        cache_key_evaluations += 1
        cache_key_item_reads += items
        cache_key_requirement_coordinate_reads += requirement_reads
        cache_key_duration_reads += duration_reads
        cache_key_completion_offset_reads += offset_reads
        return signature

    best_indices: tuple[int | None, ...] = (None,) * lanes
    best_service = (0,) * len(queue)
    best_duration = idle_duration
    best_score = 0.0
    attempts = 1
    feasible_count = 1
    candidate_score_evaluations = 1
    idle_key = cache_key(())
    cache: dict[tuple, _Candidate] = {
        idle_key: _Candidate(True, best_service, 0, idle_duration, 0.0)
    }

    def consider(
        indices: tuple[int | None, ...], candidate: _Candidate, *, evaluated: bool
    ) -> None:
        nonlocal best_indices, best_service, best_duration, best_score
        nonlocal feasible_count, candidate_score_evaluations
        if evaluated:
            feasible_count += 1
            candidate_score_evaluations += 1
        padded = pad(indices)
        key = (
            candidate.duration,
            tuple(len(options) if index is None else index for index in padded),
        )
        best_key = (
            best_duration,
            tuple(len(options) if index is None else index for index in best_indices),
        )
        if candidate.score > best_score or (
            candidate.score == best_score and key < best_key
        ):
            best_indices = padded
            best_service = candidate.service
            best_duration = candidate.duration
            best_score = candidate.score

    seed_copies: list[int] = []
    seed_signature_collisions = 0
    for index, counts in enumerate(requirements):
        attempts += 1
        copies = min(
            lanes,
            min(q // count for q, count in zip(queue, counts) if count),
        )
        seed_copies.append(copies)
        if copies:
            service = tuple(copies * count for count in counts)
            numerator = copies * weights[index]
            candidate = _Candidate(
                True, service, numerator, durations[index], numerator / durations[index]
            )
            key = cache_key((index,) * copies)
            cached_seed = cache.get(key)
            if cached_seed is None:
                cache[key] = candidate
            elif cached_seed != candidate:
                raise RuntimeError("equal seed execution signatures disagree")
            else:
                seed_signature_collisions += 1
            consider((index,) * copies, candidate, evaluated=True)
        else:
            # The paid zero-copy seed proves that even one copy is infeasible.
            # Associate that proof with the padded singleton encountered later.
            service = requirements[index]
            key = cache_key((index,))
            candidate = _Candidate(
                False, service, weights[index], durations[index], 0.0
            )
            cached_seed = cache.get(key)
            if cached_seed is None:
                cache[key] = candidate
            elif cached_seed.feasible:
                raise RuntimeError("equal seed execution signatures disagree")
            else:
                seed_signature_collisions += 1

    ordered: tuple[int | None, ...] = tuple(
        sorted(
            range(len(options)),
            key=lambda index: (
                seed_copies[index] == 0,
                -weights[index],
                index,
            ),
        )
    ) + (None,)
    local_weights = tuple(
        0 if index is None else weights[index] for index in ordered
    )
    local_durations = tuple(
        idle_duration if index is None else durations[index] for index in ordered
    )
    local_requirements = tuple(
        (0,) * len(queue) if index is None else requirements[index]
        for index in ordered
    )
    thresholds = tuple(sorted({idle_duration, *durations}))
    bound_probes = 0
    threshold_evaluations = 0

    tables = []
    for duration in thresholds:
        max_weights = [0] * (len(ordered) + 1)
        max_counts = [(0,) * len(queue)] * (len(ordered) + 1)
        for position in range(len(ordered) - 1, -1, -1):
            bound_probes += 1
            max_weights[position] = max_weights[position + 1]
            max_counts[position] = max_counts[position + 1]
            if local_durations[position] <= duration:
                max_weights[position] = max(
                    max_weights[position], local_weights[position]
                )
                max_counts[position] = tuple(
                    max(old, count)
                    for old, count in zip(
                        max_counts[position], local_requirements[position]
                    )
                )
        tables.append((duration, max_weights, max_counts))

    upper_bound_calls = 0

    def upper_bound(prefix: _Prefix) -> float:
        nonlocal threshold_evaluations, upper_bound_calls
        upper_bound_calls += 1
        remaining = lanes - len(prefix.indices)
        residual = tuple(q - used for q, used in zip(queue, prefix.service))
        best_upper = 0.0
        for duration, max_weights, max_counts in tables:
            if duration < prefix.duration:
                continue
            threshold_evaluations += 1
            weighted_cap = (
                max_weights[prefix.next_index]
                + (remaining - 1) * max_weights[0]
            )
            queue_cap = sum(
                q * min(left, first + (remaining - 1) * other)
                for q, left, first, other in zip(
                    queue,
                    residual,
                    max_counts[prefix.next_index],
                    max_counts[0],
                )
            )
            numerator = prefix.numerator + min(weighted_cap, queue_cap)
            best_upper = max(best_upper, numerator / duration)
        return best_upper

    frontier: list[tuple[float, int, _Prefix]] = []
    serial = 0
    frontier_peak = 0
    frontier_pushes = 0
    bound_rejected_prefixes = 0

    def push(prefix: _Prefix) -> None:
        nonlocal serial, frontier_peak, frontier_pushes, bound_rejected_prefixes
        upper = upper_bound(prefix)
        if upper > best_score:
            heapq.heappush(frontier, (-upper, serial, prefix))
            serial += 1
            frontier_pushes += 1
            frontier_peak = max(frontier_peak, len(frontier))
        else:
            bound_rejected_prefixes += 1

    logical_search_pops = 0
    paid_search_pops = 0
    free_cache_hit_pops = 0
    cached_feasible_reuses = 0
    cached_infeasible_reuses = 0
    budget_blocked_cache_miss_lookups = 0
    exact_stop_cleared = 0

    push(_Prefix((), (0,) * len(queue), 0, idle_duration, 0))
    while frontier:
        negative_upper, _, prefix = frontier[0]
        if -negative_upper <= best_score:
            exact_stop_cleared = len(frontier)
            frontier.clear()
            break

        position = prefix.next_index
        index = ordered[position]
        raw_indices = prefix.indices + (index,)
        key = cache_key(raw_indices)
        cached = cache.get(key)
        if cached is None and attempts >= budget:
            budget_blocked_cache_miss_lookups += 1
            break

        heapq.heappop(frontier)
        logical_search_pops += 1
        if cached is None:
            attempts += 1
            paid_search_pops += 1
            counts = (
                (0,) * len(queue) if index is None else requirements[index]
            )
            service = tuple(
                old + count for old, count in zip(prefix.service, counts)
            )
            feasible = all(count <= q for count, q in zip(service, queue))
            if feasible:
                numerator = prefix.numerator + local_weights[position]
                duration = max(prefix.duration, local_durations[position])
                cached = _Candidate(
                    True, service, numerator, duration, numerator / duration
                )
                consider(raw_indices, cached, evaluated=True)
            else:
                cached = _Candidate(False, service, 0, idle_duration, 0.0)
            cache[key] = cached
        else:
            free_cache_hit_pops += 1
            if cached.feasible:
                cached_feasible_reuses += 1
                consider(raw_indices, cached, evaluated=False)
            else:
                cached_infeasible_reuses += 1

        if cached.feasible and len(raw_indices) < lanes:
            push(_Prefix(
                raw_indices,
                cached.service,
                cached.numerator,
                cached.duration,
                0,
            ))
        if position + 1 < len(ordered):
            push(_Prefix(
                prefix.indices,
                prefix.service,
                prefix.numerator,
                prefix.duration,
                position + 1,
            ))

    upper = max(best_score, -frontier[0][0] if frontier else best_score)
    gap = max(0.0, upper - best_score)
    queue_norm = sum(queue)
    return FifoExecutionQuotientFrameSelection(
        option_indices=best_indices,
        service=best_service,
        duration=best_duration,
        score=best_score,
        upper_bound=upper,
        gap=gap,
        epsilon=gap / queue_norm if queue_norm else 0.0,
        attempts=attempts,
        seed_attempts=seed_attempts,
        feasible_candidate_count=feasible_count,
        local_score_evaluations=len(options),
        bound_option_probes=bound_probes,
        bound_threshold_evaluations=threshold_evaluations,
        frontier_peak=frontier_peak,
        exact=gap == 0.0,
        represented_ordered_configurations=represented_ordered,
        cache_entries=len(cache),
        cache_hits=free_cache_hit_pops,
        cache_misses_after_seeds=paid_search_pops,
        seed_signature_collisions=seed_signature_collisions,
        logical_search_pops=logical_search_pops,
        paid_search_pops=paid_search_pops,
        free_cache_hit_pops=free_cache_hit_pops,
        cached_feasible_reuses=cached_feasible_reuses,
        cached_infeasible_reuses=cached_infeasible_reuses,
        candidate_score_evaluations=candidate_score_evaluations,
        cache_key_evaluations=cache_key_evaluations,

            for index in option_indices

        for coordinate in range(len(model.workloads))
    )
    duration = max((

        *(model.options[index].duration for index in option_indices if index is not None),
    ))
    return service, float(duration)

        model.options,
        option_indices,
        model.lanes,
        len(model.workloads),
    )
    reads = sum(
        len(model.options[index].completion_offsets[coordinate])
        for index in option_indices
        if index is not None
        for coordinate in range(len(model.workloads))
    )
    return _signature_dict(signature, "completion_offset_sequences"), reads


def _physical_signature(model, option_indices):
    service, duration = _service_duration(model, option_indices)
    reads = 0
    offsets = []
    for coordinate in range(len(model.workloads)):
        local = []
        for option_index in option_indices:
            if option_index is None:
                continue
            for offset in model.options[option_index].completion_offsets[coordinate]:
                reads += 1
                local.append(float(offset))
        offsets.append(tuple(sorted(local)))
    signature = (service, duration, tuple(offsets))
    return _signature_dict(signature, "completion_offset_multisets"), reads

def _evaluate_state(model, known_pairs, state_index, state, source_exact):

    )
    exact = select_fifo_execution_quotient_frame(
        model.options, queues, model.lanes, EXACT_FIFO_BUDGET
    )
    reference_score = state["support_reference_score"]
    legacy = state["legacy_k26"]
    support_regret = reference_score - small.score
    bound_slack = small.upper_bound - reference_score
    identity_error = small.gap - support_regret - bound_slack
    epsilon_error = small.epsilon - (
        small.gap / sum(queues) if sum(queues) else 0.0
    )
    legacy_signatures, legacy_reads = _action_signatures(
        model, legacy["option_indices"]
    )
    small_signatures, small_reads = _action_signatures(model, small.option_indices)
    exact_signatures, exact_reads = _action_signatures(model, exact.option_indices)
    source_exact_signatures, source_exact_reads = _action_signatures(
        model, source_exact["option_indices"]
    )
    raw_changed = small_signatures["raw"] != legacy_signatures["raw"]
    physical_changed = (
        small_signatures["physical"] != legacy_signatures["physical"]
    )
    fifo_changed = (
        small_signatures["fifo_execution"]
        != legacy_signatures["fifo_execution"]
    )
    known_raw_ids = _matching_pair_ids(
        known_pairs, queues, legacy_signatures, small_signatures, "raw"
    )
    known_physical_ids = _matching_pair_ids(
        known_pairs, queues, legacy_signatures, small_signatures, "physical"
    )
    known_fifo_ids = _matching_pair_ids(
        known_pairs, queues, legacy_signatures, small_signatures, "fifo_execution"
    )
    known_raw = bool(known_raw_ids)
    known_physical = bool(known_physical_ids)
    known_fifo = bool(known_fifo_ids)
    score_delta = small.score - legacy["score"]
    upper_delta = small.upper_bound - legacy["upper_bound"]
    gap_delta = small.gap - legacy["gap"]
    execution_ok = (
        _realizable(model, queues, small)
        and _realizable(model, queues, exact)
        and _work_identities(small, len(model.options), model.lanes)
        and _work_identities(exact, len(model.options), model.lanes)
        and small.attempts <= SMALL_BUDGET
        and exact.attempts <= EXACT_FIFO_BUDGET
        and small.represented_ordered_configurations == ORDERED_ACTION_COUNT
        and exact.represented_ordered_configurations == ORDERED_ACTION_COUNT
        and exact.exact
        and exact.frontier_entries_remaining == 0
        and exact.budget_blocked_cache_miss_lookups == 0
        and abs(exact.gap) <= SCORE_TOLERANCE
        and abs(exact.upper_bound - exact.score) <= SCORE_TOLERANCE
        and abs(exact.epsilon) <= SCORE_TOLERANCE
        and abs(exact.score - reference_score) <= SCORE_TOLERANCE
        and small.score <= reference_score + SCORE_TOLERANCE
        and reference_score <= small.upper_bound + SCORE_TOLERANCE
        and abs(identity_error) <= SCORE_TOLERANCE
        and abs(epsilon_error) <= SCORE_TOLERANCE
    )
    return {
        "state_index": state_index,
